name: rdc
description: See and control other computers that run RDC: connect by link or code, then work from screenshots with the mouse and keyboard.
long_description: RDC is a lightweight open-source remote desktop. Run it on the computer to control; it shows a link and a 9-digit code. Give the link to Claude: it connects, takes screenshots and uses the mouse and keyboard there. The person at that computer sees that an AI agent is connected and can stop it at any time.

tools.name: connect
tools.description: Connect to a computer by its RDC link or address and code

tools.name: disconnect
tools.description: End the session with a computer

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: The current screen, or an enlarged region of it

tools.name: click
tools.description: Click at a point: left, right or middle, single or double, with modifiers

tools.name: drag
tools.description: Drag from one point to another

tools.name: type
tools.description: Type Unicode text into the focused field

tools.name: wait
tools.description: Wait for the screen to change, then screenshot
